class_id: an abstention recorded as a disagreement
feature: data_conflicts write path; any queue whose rows are meant to carry a human judgement call
symptom: a comparison writes a queue row whenever two sources are not equal, without first asking whether both sources actually SUPPLIED a value. One side null is not a disagreement, it is an absence, and it needs a different remedy (fetch it, or record why it is missing) from a real value-vs-value conflict (decide which is right). The same shape covers a source compared against ITSELF across time: the pair is not two sources, so the row cannot be a source conflict, it is churn. Universal shape: a queue that filters on `a <> b` rather than on `a IS NOT NULL AND b IS NOT NULL AND a <> b` will fill with rows nobody can action, and its size stops carrying information. The tell: the queue grows far faster than the number of genuinely ambiguous facts in the domain, and its rows are dominated by one source or one null side.
first_seen: 2026-09-20 — issue #818, measured read-only on ipodhan_staging. 28,120 open admin-queue rows across 268 IPOs. Of the 14,140 data_conflicts rows: 13,850 (97.9%) had one side null, 133 (0.9%) held identical values, and only 157 (1.1%) were a true value-vs-value disagreement. 12,152 (86%) were CHITTORGARH compared against CHITTORGARH — one source against its own earlier value. 14,134 (99.96%) sat on IPOs already CLOSED or LISTED. IMPORTANT, established the same night: these rows are HISTORICAL RESIDUE, not a live defect. Same-source rows stop at 2026-08-23 and the guard landed 2026-09-03 (a7aa991e, W-79); null-side rows stop at 2026-08-24 and the last null guard landed 2026-09-16 (59f14418); zero rows of either kind exist after their guard dates. 12,731 of the 12,774 same-source rows were written in the single week of 2026-08-17 — one bad run, not a drip. Staging's deployed build 61808af1 CONTAINS a7aa991e (git merge-base --is-ancestor), and the open backlog FELL from 14,252 (2026-09-07 baseline) to 14,140, which a live unguarded writer cannot do
fix_prs: guarded in code before this class was written down: a7aa991e (2026-09-03, refuses source1 === source2 in logConflict and upsertConflict), 642e2838 (2026-08-24) and 59f14418 (2026-09-16) for the null cases (NOTHING_TO_RECORD / NO_INCOMING_VALUE), plus the existingSource !== incomingSource gate on the consolidation service's Case 3 write. detection_check: none yet, and the gap is specific: the guards stop new rows but nothing asserts the queue's COMPOSITION, so a recurrence would again be visible only as a large count. A check on this class asserts that the share of open rows which are true value-vs-value disagreements on a live IPO dominates, and treats an excess of abstentions or same-source pairs as a write-path defect rather than a backlog. scripts/ops/admin-queue-size.mjs (item 35) reports the open COUNT grouped by IPO, which is exactly the number this class makes uninformative — 28,120 and 157 read identically to it. Note this class has now recurred TWICE in code before being written down (9,921 of 11,493 rows historically, then a recurrence on priceRangeMin NSE-vs-NSE, T-276), which is why a composition check matters more than another write guard
